title: Require Service Context Funnel
forbids: a standalone base without declared Dependencies plus exported InitialContext and Context; an embedded API base without Context; a module-local Context that is not applied by the exported native module chain; a root or module context assembly file; a context-shape declaration outside base.ts or module.ts; a module alias edge to raw root context; a router reopening raw service lanes; a middleware source without a named native const or derivative; a middleware default export; or a native .use attachment whose first argument is inline or a local plain callback
why: Context narrows from the base-owned service boundary through each exact service branch in module.ts into router handlers, while named native middleware keeps qualified guards and enrichment visible at every attachment boundary.
remediate: Declare external Dependencies plus exported InitialContext and Context in standalone base.ts, and Context in embedded API base.ts. Let a bare module inherit service context. When a module narrows or enriches context, declare its local Context in module.ts and apply it through named middleware on the exported service.<module> chain. Delete context assembly files and consume only narrowed capabilities in handlers. Give every other middleware source a named const created from native os, decorateMiddleware, base, service, or module authority, or a native mapInput/concat derivative. Remove default exports and pass a bare named middleware reference as the first argument to native .use calls.
message: Service context must narrow through native boundaries and .use must attach named native middleware.
